objectives: 盆地分析的目的是重建沉積盆地的演化歷史。內容包括瞭解形成盆地的機制與過程、沉積物堆積的過程與盆地古環境變遷。
content:
課程綱要
Sedimentary basins in their plate tectonic environment
2. Lithospheric mechanics
3. Basins due to lithospheric stretching and the development of passive continental margins
4. Basins due to orogenic loading
5. Basins associated with subduction processes
6. Basins associated with strike-slip deformation
7. Controls on basin stratigraphy
books:
“Allen, P. A. ＆ J. R. Allen, 2005, Basin analysis: principles ＆ applications: Blackwell Science., Oxford, UK, 549 pp.
Busby, C. J. ＆ R. V. Ingersoll, 1995, Tectonics of sedimentary basins: Blackwell Science, Oxford, UK, 579 pp.
Watts, A. B., 2001, Isostasy and flexure of the lithosphere: Cambridge University Press, Cambridge, UK, 458 pp.“
